methods.orientation: (-5-3)*(gx^2+gy^2); body_names selection does not change the root-gravity read in these two functions.
methods.angvel: -0.1*(wx_body^2+wy_body^2); the two axis components are decomposed for accounting only, not separate configuration weights.
methods.units: weighted_rate_mean is weight*raw before multiplying dt; step=rate*0.02; window sum=sum(step), no discount.
methods.teacher_blend: For teacher PPO transitions: 0.7*AMP_step+0.3*task_step. Actual AMP score not in telemetry; do not claim actual component percentages.
methods.timing: Telemetry is post-physics; fixed command explicitly set before each step; no resets in analyzed cases; windows half-open.
methods.scope: Deterministic evaluated policy under one seed; not on-policy training samples or a policy-response prediction.
methods.counterfactual: Only reweights the identical recorded states; it cannot predict future optimized policy, advantages or convergence.
methods.body_axes: Body wx/wy are not exactly Euler roll/pitch derivatives when the body is tilted and yawing.
